transferred: Actual glove overlaps orange cheek with small contour indentation and white contact burst; surprised ram face, raised near forehoof; heroine legs braced in wide stance. Very low camera and complete punch arm.
gaps: Anatomical LEFT arm now wears circle and punches; RIGHT bent arm wears crescent. Both sides reverse versus ST01–05. White burst covers some interface, cheek displacement remains shallow, and impact lies at outer mid-cheek rather than lower cheek. Torso remains almost front-facing with limited hip rotation. Three ram feet are clear; fourth is occluded, not enough evidence to declare missing leg. Crescent chip not clearly retained.
observations.priority: High-value structural repair candidate: correct right-arm punch and side-consistent gloves with visibly compressed lower-cheek contact. Prefer this central payoff over BP02 setup hand/root issues.
observations.independence_note: Root mentioned suspected arm/cheek issues before this review; actual native inspected directly, so this is corroboration rather than blind review.
